summary:
Comprehensive architectural specification and implementation plan for:
1. Admin Dashboard room status display ('Running' in red) and deletion confirmation modal.
2. Fix for real player vs [BOT] tag and multiplayer synchronization.
3. Procedural multi-room facility layout with central corridor, realistic walls, and automatic fixed furniture.
4. Physical doors with push kinematics, one-sided lock/unlock handle interaction, and real-time state sync.
5. First Person (eye-level, full wall occlusion, hidden self) and Third Person (enlarged view, visible self) camera systems.
6. Synced sound effects for walking, running, jumping, door push, and door locks.
7. WhatsApp-style chat improvements: long-press activation only, icon-based top selection bar, smart delete-for-me vs delete-for-everyone modal flow, inline edit icon, dynamic date dropdown header, and admin-only date chat purge.
8. Admin session propagation into the game arena.
